fusions.name: Saddle Shot
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at the first enemy in line for 7 damage, rising by 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (up to 30%). It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Parthian Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows in a spread, each dealing 10 damage and knocking its target 2 tiles back. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Running Draw
fusions.desc: You attack 25% faster for 10 seconds and move 25% faster for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Mount
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
